ui.printstage.title: Ku habee walxaha miiska printerkaaga oo u dir printerka
ps.title: Goobta daabacaadda
ps.lab: Cusub dhismahan. Daabacyada ugu horreeya fiiro gelin: qaybiyahan weli ma isticmaalin printer badan.
ps.lib.none: Waxba maktabadda kuma jiro oo la mid ah.
ps.add.nobody: Walxan ma leh qaab 3D ah oo la daabaco.
ps.add.done: {name} waxa uu miiska ku jiraa cabbirka buuxa.
ps.add.scaled: {name} waxa uu miiska ku jiraa 1:{n} si uu ugu habboon yahay.
ps.stage.empty: Wali waxba halkan ma jiro. Maktabadda ka dar wax, ama sawir ama soo geli moodeel: wixii muuqda oo dhan ayaa la daabacayaa.
ps.stage.move: Ku dhaqaaq, ku leff u rog oo ku cabbir waxyaabaha muuqaalka adigoo isticmaalaya qalabka caadiga ah. Khadka jajabka ah waa miiskaaga.
ps.stage.overlap: Qaar sanduuq ayaa isku dul maray. Taasi way fiican tahay haddii qaababka aan taabanayn; qaababka taabanaya waxay u daabacmaan hal qayb.
ps.arrange.left: {n} ma ku habboonaan. Yaree cabbirkooda ama daabac socod kale.
ps.engine.cadcraft: CadCraft basic (ku jira, ugu dhakhsaha badan)
ps.link.needs_studio: Printerkan wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa CadCraft Studio kombiyuutarka. Moodeelkan Studio ku fur si aad u dirto.
ps.link.slicer: Printerkan wuxuu isticmaalaa OrcaSlicer oo leh presets-kiisa. Agabka, tayada, buuxinta iyo taageerayaasha hoose ayaa weli ku shaqeeya; heerkulka waxa uu ka yimaadaa preset-ka.
ps.engine.need.needs_studio: {name} barnaamij gaar ah ayuu yahay, sidaas darteed CadCraft Studio kombiyuutarka ayuu ka shaqeeyaa. Halkan slicer kale dooro, ama tan Studio ku fur.
ps.tech.label: Daabacaadda oo leh
ps.printer.ender3: Nooca Ender-3, 220 × 220 × 250 mm (G-code bilaabid oo gaar ah)
ps.printer.mk4: Nooca Prusa MK4, 250 × 210 × 220 mm (G-code bilaabid oo gaar ah)
ps.printer.klipper250: Printer Klipper ah, 250 × 250 × 250 mm (G-code bilaabid oo gaar ah)
ps.field.bridges: Godadka buuxinta (waa la dul mariyaa, gaabisa, dabbaalku buuxa)
ps.preview.ready: Diyaar: {n} lakab. Jiirka dhaqaaq si aad uga eegto kahor intaanan dirin.
ps.preview.canvas: Lakabka la jeexay sida kor laga arko, oo ku yaal khadka miiska
ps.preview.layer: Lakab {n} oo ka mid ah {total}, {z} mm kor
ps.preview.bridges: {n} godad la buuxiyay, oo midab liin ah lagu sawiray.
ps.preview.stale: Goobta ama dejintu way isbedeshay tan ka dib markii la jeexay. Dib u taabo Hor-eeg lakabyada.
ps.usb.none: Daabacaadda USB waxay u baahan tahay Chrome ama Edge kombiyuutar. Printer shabakad ahi halkan ayuu sidoo kale ka shaqeeyaa.
ps.net.note: Printerka waa inuu oggolaadaa degelkan. Moonraker gudaha, degelkan ku dar cors_domains; OctoPrint gudaha, CORS hur oo furaha API koobiyee. Browser-kaagu wuxuu weydiin karaa inuu gaari karo aaladaha shabakadaada: ha, ogolow.
ps.send.empty: Miiska wax daabacaad ah kuma jiraan.
ps.send.off: Marka hore kuwan miiska ku dar: {names}.
ps.send.check: Miiska ma nadiif yahay, agabka saxda ahna ma shubtay? Printerku wuu kululaan doonaa oo dhaqdhaqaaqi doonaa.
ps.send.summary: Qiyaas ahaan {time}, {grams} g agab, {layers} lakab. Afka {temp} °C, miiska {bed} °C.
ps.send.usb_note: USB dhexdiisa, bogga furan ku hay ilaa daabacaaddu dhammaato. Isaga xidhidhka oo jooga wuxuu joojinayaa qulqulka, kulaylkuna wuu sii shidmi doonaa ilaa printerku wakhtiga ka baxo.
ps.send.started: La diray. Printerku wuu bilaabayaa: qiyaas ahaan {time}.
ps.send.usb_done: Waxa oo dhan la diray, daabacaaddana way dhammaatay.
ps.send.stopped: Waa la joojiyay. Kulaylka, dabbaalka iyo mishiinnada way damaan.
ps.warn.skipped_one: Hal qayb ma leh dhumuc ama lama xirin karo, sidaas darteed way ka maqnaan doontaa ({share}% qaabka).
ps.warn.skipped: {n} qaybood ma leh dhumuc ama lama xirin karo, sidaas darteed way ka maqnaan doonaan ({share}% qaabka).
ps.warn.sheets_one: Hal taxane fidsan (calaamad ama khad trim ah) dhumuc ma lahan, sidaas darteed hal xariiq afka ah ayaa loo daabacay.
ps.warn.sheets: {n} taxane fidsan (calaamado ama khadadka trim ah) dhumuc ma lahan, sidaas darteed hal xariiq afka ah ayaa loo daabacay.
ps.warn.thin: Ilaa {n}% lakab ah ayaa khafiif u ah afkan oo ma daabacmayo. Ka dhig mid weyn, ama qaybahaas qaro.
ps.warn.overhang: Qaybaha qaarkood hoostooda waxba ma jiro. Taageerayaasha shid, ama moodeelka u leff si ay sidaas u noqdaan.
ps.warn.floating: Moodeelku miiska kuma fadhiyo, sidaas darteed hoos ayaa loo dhigay.
ps.slice.empty: Wax la daabici karo ma jiro.
ps.slice.open: Midna qaab xiran ma aha, sidaas darteed printerku wax buuxin karo ma jiro.
ps.slice.bed: Tan miiska kuma habboona. Dhammaan miiska ku habboonee isticmaal, ama dhaqaaq gudaha khadka.
ps.fail.unreachable: Printerku ma jawaabin. Hubi cinwaanka, inuu oggolaado degelkan, iyo inay browser-kaagu gaari karo shabakadaada.
ps.fail.busy: Printerku wuxuu mashquul ku yahay daabacaad kale.
ps.fail.unsupported: Browser-kan ma isticmaali karo aaladaha USB.
ps.fail.printer: Printerku qalad ayuu soo sheegay, sidaas darteed diraya way joogsatay.
ps.pc.pick: Mid ka dooro liiska hoose si aad u leexiso.
ps.pc.flat.title: Dusha fidsan ee ugu weyn ee qaadi karta ku dhig miiska
ps.pc.turn.title: Miiska xagga rubuc wareeji
ps.pc.asdesigned.title: Dib u celi siduu qaybta u qoran yahay (sare waa sare)
ps.pc.flat.done: {name} waxa uu saaran yahay dusha fidsan oo {area} mm² ah.
ps.pc.flat.already: {name} horay ayuu ugu saaran yahay dusha fidsan ee ugu weyn.
ps.pc.flat.none: {name} dusha fidsan uma lahan oo ku fadhiisan karo. Gacanta ku leff.
ps.pc.why.open: {n} geeso furan ayuu leeyahay, sidaas darteed maqaarkiisa godad ayaa ku jira
ps.pc.why.nonmanifold: {n} geeso ayuu leeyahay oo saddex ama ka badan oo dusha ah ku kulmaan
ps.pc.why.flipped: {n} meel ayuu leeyahay oo dusha deriska ah ay jihooyin ka soo horjeedaan
ps.bim.note: Walxaha muuqaalka 3D ka dooro, ka dibna soo qaad. Waxay miiska ku yaallaan nuqul ahaan, meelahooda sida la naqshadeeyay. Halkan ku dhaqaajinta, leexinta iyo cabbirka waxay beddelaa habaynta daabacaadda oo keliya, moodeelka ma beddelayo.
ps.bim.take.sel.title: Walxaha muuqaalka 3D ka la doortay miiska ku dhig
ps.bim.take.shown: Wixii muuqda oo dhan soo qaad
ps.bim.take.shown.title: Walxaha oo dhan ee muuqaalka 3D muujinaya miiska ku dhig (ugu badnaan 300)
ps.bim.none.sel: Muuqaalka 3D wax la doortay ma jiro. Walxaha dooro, ka dibna mar kale soo qaad.
ps.bim.left: {name} miiska ka maqan yahay: maaha jidh xiran, {why}.
ps.bim.more: {n} walxood oo dheeraad ah lama soo qaadin: miiska ugu badnaan 300 wax ayuu qaadi karaa. Wax yar dooro.
ps.bim.scale.title: Miiska wax walba hal tiro ku cabbir, si saamiyadu u joogto
ps.bim.lifesize.title: Wax walba dib ugu celi cabbirkooda moodeelka (weyn badan miisaska intooda badan)
ps.bim.scaled: Hadda wax walba waxa ku jira 1 : {n}.
ps.bim.lifesized: Wax walba mar kale cabbirkooda moodeelka ayuu ku jiraa.
